standard_prerequisites.name: A separable field extension is formally smooth, so a ring map into a quotient with nilpotent kernel lifts through the quotient
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the section sigma and its compatibility.

core_obligations: By the algebra characterization proposition, the separable field extension F_p -> kappa_A is formally smooth (proof lines 34757-34758). Since the maximal ideal of A is nilpotent, the formal smoothness lifting property applied successively to the nilpotent filtration provides a ring map sigma : kappa_A -> A splitting the residue map (proof lines 34758-34760). For a local homomorphism A -> A' with separable residue extension kappa_{A'} over kappa_A, the same formal smoothness gives a lift sigma' : kappa_{A'} -> A' whose restriction to kappa_A is the image of sigma, i.e. compatible with sigma (proof lines 34760-34761).
proof_roadmap: Get formal smoothness of the separable extension (proof lines 34757-34758).
Lift the section through the nilpotent maximal ideal and arrange compatibility (proof lines 34758-34761).
